purpose: This table holds hourly ground weather observations for three New York-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) spanning January through June 2013, combined with static per-airport reference attributes (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway) denormalized onto each observation row.
usage: Read at the grain of one row per airport per observed UTC hour (airport_code, observed_hour_utc); use observed_date_local and observed_hour_local for local-time grouping, and treat wind_gust_mph, pressure_mb, and wind_dir_degrees as frequently-null measures rather than always-present ones.
limitations: The profile cannot confirm the production grain directly; airport_code plus observed_hour_utc is proposed from distinct-count arithmetic (3 x 4341 ≈ 13023 vs row_count 13014) and needs deterministic measurement to confirm. wind_gust_mph (74.6% null) and pressure_mb (11.5% null) appear to be legitimately sparse instrument readings, but the profile cannot confirm this versus a collection gap. wind_speed_mph's max value (1048.36) is far outside its sampled range and is an unresolved possible data-quality issue. captured_at is not flagged as Airbyte metadata in the profile, but its 2026 values look like a pipeline load timestamp rather than a domain attribute, and a reviewer should re-check its treatment. airport_name, airport_municipality, airport_elevation_ft, and airport_longest_runway_ft are static facts repeated across every hourly row for the same airport, inferred rather than confirmed by an explicit key relationship.
